title: SE-CaCTS: a copy-number-aware atlas of lineage- and disease-specific super-enhancers in cancer cell lines
description:
A per-super-enhancer, per-group specificity score (CaCTS for super-enhancers) computed from public H3K27ac ChIP-seq of cancer cell lines, with copy-number-aware calling and scoring and a label-permutation false discovery rate.

Release v3.1: 2,188 untreated or control experiments on 510 cell lines across 25 Oncotree lineages, 56 primary diseases and 103 subtypes; 13,754 lineage-specific, 15,699 disease-specific and 10,971 subtype-specific super-enhancers at FDR ≤ 0.10, each a super-enhancer in its own group and labelled by how it depends on copy number (CN-robust, CN-unmasked; amplicon-driven and gain-dependent calls listed apart). Includes the pipeline code and a static dashboard of the results (https://thirtysix.github.io/SE-CaCTS/).

Code is MIT-licensed. Derived data files keep the terms of their sources (see DATA_SOURCES.md); phase2/data/cn_ccle_snp6.hg38.tsv.gz is under ODbL 1.0.
